name: FindFileInFolderNode
label: Find File in Folder
description: Finds a single file in a folder based on criteria such as largest, smallest, newest, or oldest. Optionally searches subfolders.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FolderPath
fields.label: Folder path
fields.description: The absolute path of the folder to search in (e.g., 'C:\Documents\Reports').

fields.name: SearchOption
fields.label: Search criteria
fields.description: The criterion used to select the file. Default: Largest.

selectOptions.label: Largest
selectOptions.description: Find the largest file by size.

selectOptions.label: Smallest
selectOptions.description: Find the smallest file by size.

selectOptions.label: Newest modified
selectOptions.description: Find the most recently modified file.

selectOptions.label: Oldest modified
selectOptions.description: Find the least recently modified file.

selectOptions.label: Newest created
selectOptions.description: Find the most recently created file.

selectOptions.label: First alphabetical
selectOptions.description: Find the first file when sorted alphabetically by name.

selectOptions.label: Last alphabetical
selectOptions.description: Find the last file when sorted alphabetically by name.

fields.name: FileFilter
fields.label: File filter
fields.description: One or more file patterns separated by semicolons (e.g., '*.txt' or '*.jpg;*.png'). Default: '*' (all files).

fields.name: IncludeSubfolders
fields.label: Include subfolders
fields.description: When true, searches all subfolders recursively. Default: true.

fields.name: ResultFilePath
fields.label: Result file path
fields.description: The full path of the file that matched the search criteria, or empty if no match was found.
